claim.en: Adding people to a late project makes it later.
claim.zh: 给已经延期的项目加人，会让它更晚交付。

grade_why.en: The rule rests on one author's experience and on simulations. We found no controlled test of adding staff to late projects.
grade_why.zh: 该定律基于作者个人经验和仿真模型，我们没有找到对延期项目加人的对照研究。

evidence.en: Brooks (1975) drew the rule from managing IBM's OS/360 project and introduced it with the words "oversimplifying outrageously". His reasons: newcomers need training, communication grows with headcount, and the work must be re-split. In Abdel-Hamid and Madnick's 1991 project simulation, late additions always raised cost but did not always delay delivery. Timing and how many people were added mattered. Open-source data (Scholtes, 58 projects) show output per developer falling in larger teams. That fits the overhead argument but does not test late additions.
evidence.zh: Brooks（1975）依据自己管理 IBM OS/360 项目的经验提出这条规律，并坦言这是“夸张的简化”。他给出的理由：新人需要培训，沟通成本随人数增长，工作还要重新拆分。Abdel-Hamid 和 Madnick（1991）的项目仿真显示：后期加人总会推高成本，但不一定拖慢交付，关键看加人的时机和数量。Scholtes 等人的开源数据（58 个项目）显示团队越大人均产出越低，这与沟通开销的解释一致，但并没有检验“后期加人”。

caveats.en: A simulation reflects its builders' assumptions. Outcomes depend on why the project is late, how well the work splits, and how new people are onboarded. Larger-team data do not isolate additions made late.
caveats.zh: 仿真结果取决于建模假设。结果还取决于项目延期的原因、工作能否拆分，以及新人的上手方式。大团队数据也无法单独识别“后期加人”的影响。

boss_line.en: Brooks himself called it an oversimplification. In Abdel-Hamid and Madnick's simulation, late hires always raised cost but did not always delay delivery. So let's ask what the new people would take on, and who would train them.
boss_line.zh: Brooks 本人也说这是过分简化。在 Abdel-Hamid 和 Madnick 的仿真中，后期加人总会推高成本，但不一定拖慢交付。所以先问清楚：新人接手什么工作，由谁带。

change_my_mind.en: A large study of real projects showing that staff added late consistently slipped delivery dates, or consistently did not, after adjusting for project size and the reason for lateness.
change_my_mind.zh: 一项针对真实项目的大型研究，在校正项目规模和延期原因后，一致显示后期加人会（或不会）造成交付延后。

hook.en: Brooks called it an oversimplification. In the best-known simulation, late hires always raised cost but did not always delay delivery.
hook.zh: 布鲁克斯自己说这是过度简化。在最有名的模拟里，晚加人总会推高成本，但不一定拖延交付。
